resources.string: Sensitive Advanced: protected receiver stream
Off by default. This is not normal monitoring and does not upload anything. It can only ever use one receiver that you pair and review.
Show protected receiver controls
Receiver setup is visible. A stream starts only after fresh pairing and session review.
Receiver controls are hidden; nothing is paired, connected, or sent from this screen.
1. Set up one receiver

Enter only a literal IPv4 or IPv6 address, not a name. Enter the receiver\'s P-256 public key and its SHA-256 fingerprint from a trusted out-of-band source. APK Sentinel never discovers receivers or uses DNS.
Receiver IP address
Example: 192.0.2.10 or 2001:db8::10. Names, loopback, multicast, and broadcast addresses are refused.
Receiver TLS port
A port from 1 to 65535. This does not open a connection.
Receiver key ID
A short identifier supplied by the receiver operator.
Receiver P-256 public key (Base64 X.509)
Public pairing material only, maximum 6,000 characters. Private keys and passwords are never accepted.
Receiver SHA-256 fingerprint
Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Verify it outside this app before continuing.
I independently verified this exact address and fingerprint

Default data categories, if this feature is ever enabled: minimal metadata and packets already classified upstream as raw encrypted. No decrypted payloads, credentials, exports, copies, sharing, cloud, listener, UDP, or discovery.
Hard session limits: 2,000 records, 8 MiB total, 16 KiB per record, 32 queued records, 256 KiB queue, and 10 minutes. Input is encrypted again in memory before it could be queued.
Only audited metadata and upstream-classified raw-encrypted records may be offered. No decrypted payload or credential source exists, and records are never retained for retry.
I approve one fresh, limited receiver session after a compatible receiver is verified
This acknowledgement is session-only and would expire within 15 minutes.
A separate fresh acknowledgement would be required for every future session.
Start protected receiver stream
The connection is one outbound pinned mTLS session. It stops on background, VPN/network change, consent expiry, process death, clock rollback, authentication loss, or any limit.
